description: Election Commission - Waga Arachchige Sunitha Violet Gunathunga was Selected as the member of the Dehiwala-Mt.Lavinia Municipal Council - Samarasinghe Hewage Danuj Niroshan Somarathna was selected as the member of the Kalutara Ubran Council
